tools.name: create_reel
tools.description: Start rendering a vertical short-form reel. Uses one reel credit per variant, reserved at start and released if the render fails. Returns job_id; poll it with get_job.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Read a reel job's state, progress and, once finished, its download URL.

tools.name: render_html
tools.description: Turn HTML the agent wrote into a vertical reel. The heading is the subject and the paragraphs are the narration. Starts the same render as create_reel. Text inside a script or style tag is not spoken. Uses one reel credit per variant. Returns job_id; poll it with get_job.

tools.name: ad_from_url
tools.description: Extract a product from a URL and draft ad angles as an Ad Studio project. With render=true, also renders ad variants for every angle in the chosen formats and aspects.

tools.name: schedule_publish
tools.description: Schedule a finished reel to auto-publish to connected TikTok, Instagram or YouTube Shorts accounts at a future UTC time.

tools.name: list_scheduled
tools.description: List your scheduled publishes and their status.

tools.name: get_performance
tools.description: Read logged performance (views, likes, retention) for one reel with job_id, or your most recent logged reels without it.

tools.name: generation_quote
tools.description: Get a signed price quote before generating: name a generation profile, or map pipeline stages to catalog model ids. Optionally cap the budget.

tools.name: wallet_balance
tools.description: Read your Menivor wallet: available and reserved balance in USD.

tools.name: list_media_models
tools.description: List Menivor's image, video and audio generation models with their integer micro-USD prices (per image, per second of video, or per audio clip).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_job · Private data: wallet_balance · Public sink: schedule_publish.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_job · Private data: wallet_balance · Public sink: schedule_publish

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
